description.value: Willow Creek Greenway is a natural trail corridor near Campbell River managed by the Greenways Land Trust, a registered charity focused on stream and land stewardship in the region. It is listed among the organization's most popular local trails and lies within the ecologically rich watersheds that drain eastward to the sea on northern Vancouver Island. Touring cyclists exploring the Campbell River area would find it a worthwhile natural detour through preserved greenway habitat.
